## Context
The RCA for broadish-permanent-condor found seven additional pytest fixtures that return a full `dict(os.environ)` directly or nested inside a rendered fixture value. Under pytest default long tracebacks, early ambient credentials can be printed verbatim through function-argument `saferepr`. Confirmed locations: `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_materialize_probe.py`, `test_autodeploy_fetch_secrets.py`, `test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py`, `test_autodeploy_health_gate.py`, `test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`, `test_observability_exit.py`, and `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py`.

## Plan
- Build a parametrized real-pytest RED oracle using insertion-ordered synthetic sentinels and deterministic failures for each fixture surface.
- Replace broad ambient copies with the minimal required environment for each harness while preserving explicit per-test mutations.
- Prove every sentinel is absent, existing suites remain green, and the exact broad-copy mutation returns the oracle to RED.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each listed fixture has a deterministic RED failure-rendering probe.
- [ ] No listed fixture returns arbitrary ambient values.
- [ ] Synthetic sentinel values are absent from default pytest failure output on every surface.
- [ ] Existing fixture consumers retain required PATH and explicit environment behavior.
- [ ] Focused suites, lint, and typecheck pass.
compiled_state.title: Prevent sibling pytest fixtures from rendering ambient credentials
